targeting.title: n8n AI Agent Memory: Session ID, Simple Memory vs Postgres and Fixes
targeting.metaTitle: n8n AI Agent Memory: Session ID, Postgres, Fixes
targeting.metaDescription: n8n AI agent memory explained: Simple Memory vs Postgres Chat Memory, per user session IDs, context window length, clearing memory, No session ID found fix.
targeting.excerpt: A source-verified guide to n8n AI agent memory: how session IDs are resolved and scoped, how Simple Memory stores and expires history, what Context Window Length counts, Postgres Chat Memory setup and pruning, Chat Memory Manager, per user memory for Telegram and WhatsApp, and fixes for the errors.
targeting.keywords: n8n ai agent memory, n8n simple memory, n8n simple memory session id, n8n postgres chat memory, n8n ai agent memory session id, n8n simple memory context window length, n8n ai agent clear memory, n8n chat memory manager, n8n simple memory vs postgres, n8n no session id found
targeting.summary: Memory is a per session message list replayed into the prompt; the Session ID decides who shares it, and version 1.4 nodes append their own name to the key in the default mode|Simple Memory lives in the n8n process, drops sessions idle for 60 minutes and is lost on restart or in queue mode; Postgres and Redis Chat Memory persist|Context Window Length counts stored messages, not tokens, and tool calls consume extra messages; clear or inspect memory with the Chat Memory Manager on the same memory node
targeting.author: Ali Rehman

overlap.note: No existing post covers AI agent memory, Simple Memory, session IDs or Postgres Chat Memory; this is the site's first AI agent article and links into the n8n cluster.

research.selection: Thirty fresh seeds across three candidate clusters. AI agent memory was the richest by far: 'n8n ai agent memory' (10 suggestions: postgresql, session id, supabase, mongodb, postgres, simple memory, simple memory session id, clear memory, node memory), 'n8n simple memory' (10: session id, key, clear, context window length, node, error, session key, vs postgres, not working), 'n8n postgres chat memory' (9: supabase, setup, no session id found, node, schema, clear, error in sub node), 'n8n simple memory session key' (7: from previous node, session id error, no session id found) and 'n8n chat memory manager' (4). The out of memory cluster had one strong head and thin long tail; the Respond to Webhook cluster overlaps the existing webhook article. DuckDuckGo sampling for memory queries showed official docs, community threads and several setup level blog posts, leaving room for a source verified guide on session resolution, expiry, window arithmetic and errors.

competitorAndCaseReview.source: n8n source MemoryBufferWindow.node.ts, descriptions.ts and utils/helpers.ts at the 2.46.6 tag
competitorAndCaseReview.finding: In process map keyed workflowId__sessionId, stale sessions cleared after 60 minutes on every access, versions 1 to 1.4, Session ID options and defaults, context window default 5, getSessionId resolution order and exact error texts, session key scoping with the sanitised node name from version 1.4 (Postgres 1.4, Redis 1.6, MongoDB 1.1).

Default table n8n_chat_histories, identifier validation and error text, window only from Postgres 1.1 and Redis 1.3, Redis Session Time To Live, Chat Memory Manager operations, defaults and simplified output shape.

competitorAndCaseReview.source: n8n source agent-execution/memoryManagement.ts and ToolsAgent common.ts
competitorAndCaseReview.finding: Tool turns are saved as human, AI with tool calls, tool messages and final AI message; orphan cleanup after trimming; structured output stringified for memory; memory fetched once at item index 0.
Window returns the last k × 2 messages; Postgres table id serial, session_id varchar(255), message jsonb; reads ordered by id; clear deletes the session's rows.
